  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "CRUSH {{ing_01|BARLEY (crushed, soaked the day before, well washed)}}, PLACE ON THE FIRE TO BE COOKED [in a double boiler]"
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "WHEN HOT ADD {{ing_02|oil}}, {{ing_03|a bunch of dill}}, {{ing_04|dry onion}}, {{ing_05|satury}} AND {{ing_06|colocasium}} TO BE COOKED TOGETHER BECAUSE FOR THE BETTER JUICE, ADD {{ing_07|green coriander}} AND {{ing_08|a little salt}}; BRING IT TO A BOILING POINT."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "WHEN DONE TAKE OUT {{ing_03|the bunch [of dill]}} AND TRANSFER {{ing_01|the Barley}} INTO ANOTHER KETTLE TO AVOID STICKING TO THE BOTTOM AND BURNING, MAKE IT LIQUID [by addition of water, broth, milk]"
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "STRAIN INTO A POT, COVERING THE TOPS OF THE {{ing_06|colocasia}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "NEXT CRUSH {{ing_09|pepper}}, {{ing_10|lovage}}, {{ing_11|a little dry flea-bane}}, {{ing_12|cumin}} AND {{ing_13|sylphium}}"
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "STIR IT WELL AND ADD {{ing_14|vinegar}}, {{ing_15|reduced must}} AND {{ing_16|broth}};"
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "PUT IT BACK INTO THE POT, {{ing_06|the remaining colocasia}} FINISH ON A GENTLE FIRE."
    }
  ],
